description: This Python source file implements CRUD operations and utility functions for user authentication and task management in a task management system backend, using frameworks like SQLAlchemy and FastAPI.

methods.name: get_db()
methods.description: Dependency generator for establishing and closing database sessions per request.

methods.name: get_password_hash(password: str)
methods.description: Returns a hashed version of the provided password using bcrypt.

methods.name: verify_password(plain_password, hashed_password)
methods.description: Verifies that a plain password matches the hashed password.

methods.name: create_access_token(data: dict, expires_delta: timedelta = None)
methods.description: Generates a JWT token with optional expiration.

methods.name: create_user(db: Session, user_in: UserCreate)
methods.description: Creates a new user in the database if the email isn't already registered.

methods.name: authenticate_user(db: Session, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Authenticates a user given email and password.

methods.name: get_user_by_id(db: Session, user_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a user record by user ID.

methods.name: create_task_for_user(db: Session, user_id: int, task_in: TaskCreate)
methods.description: Creates a new task associated with a user.

methods.name: get_task(db: Session, user_id: int, task_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches a specific task for a user by task ID.

methods.name: update_task(db: Session, user_id: int, task_id: int, task_in: TaskUpdate)
methods.description: Updates details of an existing task.

methods.name: delete_task(db: Session, user_id: int, task_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a specified task for a user, if it exists.

methods.name: list_tasks( db: Session, user_id: int, task_status: str = None, sort_by: str = None, sort_order: str = "asc", skip: int = 0, limit: int = 20 )
methods.description: Lists tasks for a user with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.
